title: The Joinchat WordPress plugin before 6.4.2 does not escape the message of its button block before outputting it in an…
description: The Joinchat WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.4.2 contain a vulnerability where the message of its button block is not properly escaped before being output in an HTML attribute on the front end. This flaw allows users with Author role or higher to execute stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks against visitors of the post, including administrators.
